name: NOZOKI-ma
source:
Main character inherits grandfather's apartment complex. The good news is that residents are beautiful and attractive girls. It turns out that grandfather had a secret hobby as peeking spots are found everywhere. Protagonist faces a whole new experience.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公继承了祖父经营的一栋公寓。好消息是，住户全是美丽迷人的少女；坏消息是，他发现祖父有着不为人知的偷窥嗜好，公寓里到处都设有偷窥机关。主人公由此踏入一段前所未有的经历。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
